description: F2P/P2P classification of this task's graded observations. F2P fail on the delivered state and pass after the reference repair; P2P pass on both. Measured in the task image, not derived from names. tests/grade.py reads this file and runs exactly the observations it names.

groups.requirement: helper.csv() joins its non-empty arguments with its default separator, a comma followed by one space.
helper.is_date_unit() returns True only when the expression's name is one of DATE_UNITS (case-insensitively), and False for None.
helper.find_new_name() returns the base when it is not taken, otherwise the first free name in base_2, base_3, ...
normalize_table_name() normalizes the table name with the given dialect's identifier rules.
Expression.transform() does not visit the nodes of a subtree that the transformation function returned in place of a node (already transformed nodes are excluded).
Expression.pop() removes exactly that expression from its parent's list, so later pops of the remaining siblings remove the intended nodes.
helper.seq_get() returns the element at an index (negative indices count from the end) or None.
ensure_list(), ensure_collection() and flatten() wrap and flatten values as documented.
helper.csv() returns an empty string for no arguments and a single argument unchanged.
find_new_name() returns a free base unchanged and name_sequence() yields prefix0, prefix1, ...
split_num_words() splits and pads from the start or the end as documented.
is_iterable() is true for lists and dicts and false for strings and numbers.
is_date_unit() is True for the names in DATE_UNITS, case-insensitively.
dict_depth() returns the nesting depth of a dictionary as documented.
to_bool() converts true/false strings and booleans and returns other values unchanged.
merge_ranges() merges overlapping and touching ranges as documented.
to_identifier() quotes names that are not safe identifiers and copies identifiers it is given.
table_name() and normalize_table_name() render dotted table names as documented.
exp.convert() turns Python values into the documented SQL literals.
anonymize()/render() replace sensitive tokens with consistent length-preserving aliases.
diff() returns the documented sequence of edit operations.
parse_one() and Expression.sql() round-trip and pretty-print queries.
Expression.transform() visits every node when the function returns nodes unchanged.
Expression.pop() removes the expression from its parent and returns it.

parse(), parse_one(), transpile() and tokenize() behave as their docstrings and README describe.
ParseError carries structured errors, ErrorLevel controls raising, and UnsupportedError is raised at ErrorLevel.RAISE (errors.py, README Parser/Unsupported Errors).
The Tokenizer turns SQL into Tokens with type, text, line, column and comments (tokens.py, onboarding Tokenizer).
Expression.sql()/Generator options pretty, identify, normalize, pad, leading_comma and comments behave as documented (generator.py).
The Parser builds expression trees from tokens and honours error_level and parse_into (parser.py).
MappingSchema stores nested table schemas and answers column_names, get_column_type and has_column (schema.py).
serde.dump() serializes an expression tree and load() restores it (serde.py).
jsonpath.parse() turns a JSON path string into a JSONPath expression (jsonpath.py).
time.format_time() maps a format string through a mapping/trie as documented (time.py).
lineage() returns the Node graph of a column's upstream expressions (lineage.py, onboarding Column Level Lineage).
planner.Plan builds a DAG of Scan/Join/Aggregate/Sort steps from an optimized query (planner.py).
executor.execute() runs SQL over Python dict tables and returns a Table (README SQL Execution, executor/).
optimize() applies its rules with a schema, and canonicalize/isolate_table_selects rewrite as documented (optimizer/).
Expression navigation: find, find_all, walk/bfs/dfs, parent_select, alias_or_name, output_name, replace and copy (expressions/core.py, ast_primer).
Expression classes in expressions/ (functions, data types, DDL, DML, properties, constraints) parse and generate as documented.
transforms.py rewrites (eliminate_distinct_on, eliminate_qualify, unnest_to_explode) work as documented.
helper.py utilities (seq_get, ensure_list, tsort, while_changing, first, camel_to_snake_case, is_iso_date) behave as documented.
